test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill In the blank.**

The Singapore government has deported ten Indian students for______ the government rules.
solution: The correct answer is '**violating**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**violating**'. • It means** 'to break a rule, an agreement, etc.' **[(नियम, समझौते आदि का) उल्‍लंघन करना] • *Example: They were charged with **violating **federal law.* **Correct Sentence:__*** The Singapore government has deported ten Indian students for **violating** the government rules.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **vandalising**: deliberately destroy or damage (public or private property). [उपद्रव मचाना; सार्वजनिक या निजी संपत्ति को जानबूझकर नष्ट करना या नुकसान पहुंचाना] • **aiding**: to help somebody/something. (सहायता करना, मदद पहुँचाना) • **verifying**: to check or state that something is true. (किसी बात की सत्‍यता को जाँच कर प्रमाणित करना) 31:Tcc5, The correct answer is** 'No substitution required'.**
